movement_profile.footwork: Improvised basic steps matching polka rhythm
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo, pairs, or groups; space varies
movement_profile.posture: Upright with head steady to balance bottles

signature_moves.description: Balancing multiple bottles stacked atop each other on the head
signature_moves.name: Bottle stacking

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid sudden head movements that may dislodge bottles

basic_steps: Stand upright with a glass bottle balanced on the head
Extend arms to hold the ruffles of the skirt
Perform basic improvised steps to the rhythm of Paraguayan polka
Maintain steady posture and balance throughout
Advance to balancing multiple stacked bottles as skill improves
teaching.formation: Performed solo, in pairs, or in groups
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with one or two bottles; advanced dancers balance ten or more stacked bottles
